items.title: Tesla (TSLA) To End Cybertruck Production In 2027 As Cybercab Takes Priority
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) plans to end Cybertruck production in 2027 and redirect capacity to its autonomous Cybercab robotaxi program. The company aims to repurpose Cybertruck manufacturing lines for Cybercab assembly as part of a broader focus on AI driven mobility. Management positions the Cybercab as a dedicated autonomous vehicle designed for ride hailing fleets rather than individual retail buyers.
